limitations: Only maximum angular degree changes from1 to2; parameter shapes/counts and starting parameter values consequently differ.
One seed/rate/molecule and a historical control limit causal inference; improvement does not establish an angular expressivity mechanism.
Mean-zero fitting energy errors are enforced by bias calibration, not evidence of learned energy shape.
All anchors are fitted group01 structures, not held-out evaluation.
Sparse matched scores do not establish continuous stability, convergence or spike mechanism.
Both original-baseline joint and force-only gates are separate; force-only success cannot clear the joint gate.
Sequential CPU wall time is not a GPU throughput or efficiency comparison.
The full training pilot and main held-out shape-recovery study remain pending.
